description: This is the primary source code for the HomeActivity in an Android TV application. It manages the TV's home screen UI including top menu navigation, a hero banner carousel, and multiple horizontal content rails loaded dynamically from an API. The code implements custom D-pad focus navigation, scrolling behavior, and image loading with Coil, ensuring a seamless TV remote navigation experience.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: The main activity for the TV's home screen which handles focus navigation, content display, and user interaction.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the UI components, sets up focus navigation, loads data, and observes state changes.

methods.name: dispatchKeyEvent
methods.description: Overrides key event dispatching to record when the last navigation key was DPAD_UP.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top navigation menu bar with focus behavior and click actions.

methods.name: setupBannerCarousel
methods.description: Sets up the hero banner carousel, including loading images, focus handling, and dynamic content population.

methods.name: computeCenterScrollX
methods.description: Calculates the scroll position needed to horizontally center a view within a HorizontalScrollView.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Sets up multiple content rails, loads data, populates content, and manages navigation focus behavior for each row.

methods.name: moveFocusToHeroBanner
methods.description: Moves focus to the hero banner container or its first item.

methods.name: moveFocusToTopNavHome
methods.description: Moves focus to the Home button in the top menu.

methods.name: moveFocusToFirstRailFirstItem
methods.description: Focuses the first item in the first content rail.

methods.name: ensureTopScrollIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls the main ScrollView to top if focus has entered the hero carousel via DPAD_UP, ensuring top menu visibility.

methods.name: isViewFullyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a view is fully visible within the screen bounds.
